name: Medi Lifestyle Limited
summary: Medi Lifestyle Limited is an investment holding firm that offers a range of services, including placement solutions, across Malaysia, Singapore, and China. The company's operations are divided into three core segments: Healthcare, Outsourced Services, and Commodity Trading. Within its Healthcare division, it provides postpartum recovery programs under the NADORA brand. It also delivers alternative medicine and physical therapy services, such as chiropractic care, physiotherapy, and traditional Chinese medicine, all offered under the Back to Life brand. Additionally, the company is active in agricultural commodities trading, specifically dealing in coffee beans and palm oil derivatives, and is involved in the marketing and distribution of healthcare-related merchandise. Its service offerings further encompass recruitment agency activities, specialized confinement and postnatal care, consultancy, digital marketing, business process outsourcing (BPO), and human resource solutions. The group also directly manages a dedicated postpartum care facility, as well as multiple chiropractic and physiotherapy clinics. Founded in 1986 and headquartered in Singapore, the company was formerly known as IEV Holdings Limited before officially changing its name to Medi Lifestyle Limited in November 2020.
